label: Alternate modal report versus revised must-exist classification
term: alternate modal report versus revised must-exist classification
resolution: A2C2 changes a respondent modal input and retains the ordinary shared modal suffix; it does not redefine the individual class. A2P2C/A2C3 instead stipulates automatic actuality if possible, reaffirms causal exclusion for its complement, and concludes by that stipulation. Do not equate the revised complementary contingency with STMT-NB-A1-CONTINGENTS-CAUSED, NecessaryAt, a material implication, or source-definition N-to-Box-N. Distinguish possibility of some classified individual from applying that SAME individual's revised condition at the designated world. Counterfactual interpretation, membership across worlds, actual bearer guards and rigid identity remain unselected/open. Existing source causal-prefix readings and source-agnostic ancestry/modal theorems do not settle this semantic choice. A3P3B/A3C2 repeats the same alternate modal input and suffix without changing the ordinary A3 class. A3P3C/A3C3 repeats the SAME revised must-exist/complement stipulation, but re-asks possible beginning under that class, not A2’s no-uncaused-contingents report. Its otherwise identical causal prefix must be read under the changed class; essential event identity, nonrigid none-to-some scope and the earlier-existing concrete-bearer/class-persistence application gaps remain explicit. The repeated final actuality paragraph has the same revised meaning, not a new proof or ordinary necessity.
